business_summary.text: Fine Organic Industries is an Indian oleochemistry company making biobased specialty additives for foods, polymers, feeds, cosmetics and coatings, exporting to over 110 countries.

call_points.text: Raw material prices stayed elevated versus FY26, with only a marginal sequential rise over Q4FY26.
Utility costs rose significantly versus FY26 on higher fuel prices from the West Asia geopolitical crisis.
Exports were about 60% of Q1FY27 revenue; export and domestic demand both improved.
Q1FY26 had a ₹6.98 Cr business interruption settlement booked as an exceptional item; Q1FY27 had none.
FY27 and FY28 top line guided flat until the SEZ plant commissions; any growth would be price, not volume.
Thailand JV expansion deferred a few months as the team is focused on the SEZ project; Thailand plant currently runs at full scale.
All manufacturing facilities are running at almost full capacity; demand is stable with no drop seen.
Raw material prices, especially palm oil, are expected to stay higher through FY27 on biodiesel diversion and crude prices.
Freight costs rose in Q4FY26 on West Asia conflict; customers accepted FOB terms and new freight rates.
Employee cost rose about 15% in FY26 excluding a ₹7 Cr one-time gratuity provision; similar growth expected in FY27.
Board approved Mr. Shailendra Nadkarni as Non-Executive Independent Director for 5 years from May 19, 2026, subject to shareholder approval.
